title: Habakkuk — Geʽez Löfgren / Ghebre transcription
edition: Oscar Löfgren (ed.), Jona, Nahum, Habakuk, Zephanja, Haggai, Sacharja und Maleachi äthiopisch, unter Zugrundelegung des Oxforder Ms. Huntington 625, nach mehreren Handschriften. Uppsala, 1930, Habakkuk section pp. 23–32; TAU text prepared by Kefela Ghebre, published there with his permission and proofread by Ran HaCohen (October 2018).
edition_scope: The local reader transcribes the three TAU HTML text pages identified by its index as Habakkuk chapters 1–3. TAU identifies the underlying historical critical edition and states its bibliographic pages 23–32; the archive has not compared the captured digital chapter pages with that print span or manuscripts. TAU chapter page 2 is identified as Habakkuk 2 by its page title and index, but its twenty BibleGateway links target Nahum 2:1–20. That observed link anomaly is retained per unit and has not been corrected or resolved. The title-level link to the cited EOTC English list is provisional and does not establish identity with a current official EOTC edition.
transcription_note: Verse bodies are parsed from three captured TAU HTML pages. HTML whitespace is normalized to single spaces; each source-linked BibleGateway label is retained as a separate source_marker. The original pages are stored alongside this reader and checked by SHA-256. No wording was translated, silently emended, renumbered, or aligned to another witness.
editorial_signs_note: Visible Geʽez letters, punctuation, and editorial signs are retained in the extracted text. Image pages and Löfgren's critical apparatus are not bundled. The retained source HTML is the extraction authority for this reader.
chapter_structure_note: The TAU index offers text pages numbered 1–3. The captured pages contain displayed linked numbers 1–17, 1–20, and 1–19 respectively (56 total). All twenty displayed labels on page 2 link externally to Nahum 2 rather than Habakkuk 2; the source_link_target_book field preserves this discrepancy. These are observed page labels, not a verified alignment to another numbering system or evidence of print-edition completeness.

unit_label: displayed linked number; external book target is retained per unit
verification_status: Automated local validation confirms all six retained source HTML assets match the response status, byte length, and SHA-256 manifest. Parser output retains 56 nonempty sequential displayed labels across the three captured pages (chapter extents 17, 20, 19). All 20 chapter-2 links target Nahum 2, while the retained page title and menu identify Habakkuk 2; this discrepancy is exposed in each unit's source_link_target_book value. This verifies local capture-to-reader extraction and page structure only. No collation against Löfgren's 1930 print, critical apparatus, facsimile, or manuscripts was performed.
source_pages: Three local HTML pages: readers/source/habakkuk-tau-2018/habakkuk-chapter-1.html, readers/source/habakkuk-tau-2018/habakkuk-chapter-2.html, readers/source/habakkuk-tau-2018/habakkuk-chapter-3.html. The TAU index lists text pages 1–3 and separate image pages; images are not bundled.
